title: Identity blocks preserve the shifted minor ideal
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, let n,p,t,r be natural numbers, and let P be an n-by-p matrix over R. Let E=diag(P,I_t), indexed by (Fin n ⊕ Fin t) for rows and (Fin p ⊕ Fin t) for columns. For a matrix C, let D_a(C) be the ideal generated by its minors selected by embeddings from Fin a. Then D_((n+t)−r)(E)=D_(n−r)(P), where subtraction is truncated at zero, the empty determinant is 1, and an unavailable positive size gives the zero ideal.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n p t r : ℕ) (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) R), (Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin (n + t - r) ↪ (Fin n ⊕ Fin t)) (cols : Fin (n + t - r) ↪ (Fin p ⊕ Fin t)), x = Matrix.det ((Matrix.fromBlocks P 0 0 (1 : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin t) R)).submatrix rows cols)}) = Ideal.span {x : R | ∃ (rows : Fin (n - r) ↪ Fin n) (cols : Fin (n - r) ↪ Fin p), x = Matrix.det (P.submatrix rows cols)}
